input.note:
Cause: The ledger-export CronJob sets spec.activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600 (1 hour). Row volume has grown past what fits in that window, so the Job is being killed with reason DeadlineExceeded before it finishes. Per the docs, once a Job reaches activeDeadlineSeconds all its running Pods are terminated and the Job status becomes type: Failed with reason: DeadlineExceeded [cite: concepts/workloads/controllers/job#job-termination-and-cleanup-1], and this is a permanent failure requiring manual intervention [cite: concepts/workloads/controllers/job#job-termination-and-cleanup-3].

Evidence:
- Both failed pods show job_status "Failed: DeadlineExceeded (Job was active longer than specified deadline)" and last_state exit code 143 (SIGTERM).
- Logs show the container receiving SIGTERM at exactly T+60m (01:00 -> 02:00) mid-export: run 29637420 was killed at batch 69/95 of 9,412,770 rows; run 29636980 at batch 71/93 of 9,286,104 rows.
- The last success (29635540) only had 5,104,388 rows and completed in 44m49s - comfortably under the 1h deadline. So the job itself didn't change; the input size grew past the deadline.
- The SMTP "connection refused" errors are only the progress-notification emails and are unrelated to the failure (they appeared in the successful run too).

Fix the owner can apply: raise .spec.jobTemplate.spec.activeDeadlineSeconds on the ledger-export CronJob (e.g. to 10800 for a 3h ceiling, based on current ~90m runtime) and re-apply. Note that activeDeadlineSeconds takes precedence over backoffLimit, so retries won't help while the deadline is too tight [cite: concepts/workloads/controllers/job#job-termination-and-cleanup-2]. Make sure to edit the field on the Job spec level, not inside the Pod template [cite: concepts/workloads/controllers/job#job-termination-and-cleanup-3]. After bumping the deadline, trigger a manual run to backfill the missing CSVs for 2026-05-18 and 2026-05-19. The SMTP outage to 10.20.4.18:587 should be tracked as a separate ticket.
